001 / 003GENERATIVE ART — 2026

Mono
chrome.

A study in emergence. Ordered points become unpredictable topographies, shaped by noise and human input.

Generative artCanvasCreative coding

An algorithmic terrain built from interacting wavefields. Move your cursor across the image to disturb the system and discover new structures. The surface never renders exactly the same way twice.

Input: pointer / output: ordered chaos

002 / 003INTERACTION DESIGN — 2026

Shift
system.

An interface that refuses to sit still. A playful system where a grid behaves more like a living material.

InteractionSystemsRealtime

Each point is assigned a local displacement rule. Move across the composition to change the tension and watch the grid rebuild itself around your input. Pause the experiment to inspect a single moment.

Input: proximity / output: movement
SHIFT SYSTEM / STUDY 002FIELD PHYSICS / ACTIVE
HOVER OR DRAG TO DEFORM
003 / 003DIGITAL EXPERIMENT — 2025

Form
study.

A rotating three-dimensional idea, reduced to lines and light. A study in seeing something from another angle.

Procedural formGeometryMotion

A procedural surface projected onto the screen and animated in real time. Every frame redraws the form, keeping the geometry responsive without needing a video or external 3D model.

Input: time + pointer / output: form
